status: normalized execution fixture; local-source admission contract; raw original frontend typed-array requires centre compiler conversion; no Provider or formal runtime proof

rules.refs: same-scope declared upstream output; iteration container first/only array input directly references main Start declared array
rules.mappingKeys: input and output maps checked separately; nodeId + hyphen + name unique across nodes, outputs also include implicit errorCode/errorMessage; explicit same-node error name allowed
rules.retry: effective shouldRetry must be false (original Pydantic bool semantics); maxRetries does not add executions while disabled; invalid model fields remain original Factory validation
rules.schema: do not copy CNValidator; actual list and structural schema/ref checked here; detailed item/schema constraints remain original Factory execution. $ref or remote schema resolution not enabled
rules.batch: input actual array; optional absent uses declaration default or type default []; required absent rejects even with default; explicit null never selects default
rules.expanded: rootScope node count + sum(actual batchLength * innerScope node count); include each scope Start/End
rules.paths: sum materialized simple paths of root and inner scopes after source/target adjacency deduplication, independent of batchLength; DP saturation avoids path enumeration
rules.pathLength: number of nodes including Start/End, maximum over every scope

sourceFacts.types: WorkflowDSL InputSchema.type Literal array; Value.type ref with NodeRef nodeId/name non-empty strings; OutputItem.schema Dict[str,Any], required bool default false
